title: Are Multilingual LLMs Culturally-Diverse Reasoners? An Investigation into Multicultural Proverbs and Sayings

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models' ability to interpret multicultural proverbs and sayings in situational contexts across six languages, and measuring the 'culture gap' by comparing performance on original versus translated cross-cultural data.

Comparing zero-shot reasoning performance on proverb interpretation across English, Mandarin Chinese, German, Russian, Bengali, and Indonesian to identify performance disparities between high-resource and lower-resource languages.
